script_text: Something unexpected arrives on Tuesday — and it will flip your entire week on its head. Early week brings Venus in your 7th House of partnerships squaring off with your ruling planet Mercury in Taurus, stirring up relationship tension and forcing you to communicate boundaries you have been avoiding. Monday and Tuesday bring heated conversations with a partner or potential love interest, as this Aries-Taurus tension creates frustration around commitments. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trines Neptune in your 3rd House of communication, giving you the gift of psychic intuition — pay attention to your dreams and gut feelings. Mid-week brings a turning point: the Sun in late Aries opposes Saturn in your 9th House, asking you to choose between playing it safe or taking a bold risk regarding travel, education, or your long-term beliefs. Late week shifts as Venus enters Taurus and your 8th House on Saturday, bringing deeper emotional intensity to finances and intimacy — expect an unexpected money situation or power dynamic shift. Your career sector lights up Thursday with Mars in your 10th House trining Jupiter, giving you the confidence to go after what you want. Weekend brings a needed pause for rest and reflection. Your love and career both demand attention this week, and the universe is not taking no for an answer.
